ns2:course.label: Intro to Political Behavior
ns2:course.description: Analyzes the relationship between political attitudes and public opinion formation. The course also discusses political participation, political tolerance, and attitudes toward political leaders. Prerequisite: POLS 101, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: POLS 101, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
